TestCqlshCopy::test_all_datatypes_round_.description: Single node. Creates a table with a column of every CQL type (scalars, collections, tuple, nested frozen UDTs/collections), inserts one row via the driver, COPY TO csv, SELECT, TRUNCATE, COPY FROM the csv and asserts (assert_all) the table content equals the pre-truncate content. Guards cqlsh COPY serialization/parsing of all types (CASSANDRA-9302). Pure cqlsh-client behavior; server only stores/returns the row.
